title: 直升機旋翼槳葉製造
summary: 以「把旋翼槳葉的取向、質量分布與結構驗證連結」為主線，在非飛行複材槳葉剖面與試片資料台中依序完成方向性模數與應變、細長構件撓度、偏心量造成旋轉激振、孔隙與局部品質、根部、端部和方向取樣及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Connect rotor-blade orientation, mass distribution and structural verification in a Non-flying composite-blade sections and coupon-data bench, progressing through Directional modulus and strain, Deflection of a slender member, Rotating excitation from eccentricity, Porosity and local quality, Root, tip and orientation sampling, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 方向性模數與應變：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Directional modulus and strain: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 方向性模數與應變 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Directional modulus and strain and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」中，本單元處理「方向性模數與應變」。線彈性區可由應變與方向模數估應力；複材或單晶不能任用各向同性常數。
steps.instructionEn: Within Helicopter rotor-blade manufacturing, this unit examines Directional modulus and strain. Within linear elasticity, directional modulus times strain estimates stress; composites and single crystals need appropriate directionality.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：模數 E=70 GPa、應變 ε=500×10⁻⁶。關係式 σ=Eε；含輸出單位換算的算式 70e9*500e-6/1e6，結果 35 MPa。適用範圍：單軸線彈性，忽略溫度表觀應變和多軸耦合。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Modulus E=70 GPa and strain epsilon=500e-6. Relation σ=Eε; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 70e9*500e-6/1e6 gives 35 MPa. Applicability: Uniaxial linear elasticity excluding thermal apparent strain and multiaxial coupling.
steps.failure: 在「方向性模數與應變」的情境中，應變規方向貼錯會低估主應變，校正零點無法補救。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Directional modulus and strain, A misaligned strain gauge can miss principal strain; zero correction cannot fix alignment.
steps.check: 針對「方向性模數與應變」，比較空載溫度變化與機械載入曲線，先扣除可證實的零點影響。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Directional modulus and strain, Compare unloaded thermal changes with mechanical loading before correcting demonstrated offsets. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只把 ε 改為800×10⁻⁶，其餘條件固定。用 70e9*800e-6/1e6 重算，結果從 35 變成 56 MPa。先預測方向，再記下對「方向性模數與應變」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only epsilon to 800e-6, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 70e9*800e-6/1e6: 35 becomes 56 MPa. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Directional modulus and strain, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」的「方向性模數與應變：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Directional modulus and strain: Mechanism and observation” in “Helicopter rotor-blade manufacturing”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Blade section and bending load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」中，本單元處理「槳葉截面與彎曲載荷」。彎矩、距中性軸位置與截面慣性矩共同決定彎曲正應力；薄壁局部屈曲需另評。

steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Moment M=100 N m, y=0.02 m and I=2e-6 m4. Relation σ=My/I; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 100*0.02/2e-6/1e6 gives 1 MPa. Applicability: Slender-beam linear small-deflection model, not a real spar design stress.
